title: Rocket Garage
tagline: Snap together a silly rocket, then blast your animal pilot off to the Moon and beyond!
howToPlay: Tap or drag parts from the tray to build your rocket: nose cones, windows, fuel tanks, fins, boosters and stickers (tap the rocket to swap a part, tap a colour to paint it). Press the big red button to launch! When you change a part, guess first: will it go farther, the same, or less far? Watch last time's rocket fly beside yours, then hear what your change did. Every discovery goes into your 📓 notebook. Drag, or use the arrow keys, to steer and catch stars in fives. Every new planet you visit unlocks new parts, and the 🧪 workshop races rocket A against rocket B.
